boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Rhodes destinations for studying, gathering, recreation, dining, arts, and quiet outdoor time, verified against the College’s current campus guide and facility information.

cards.title: Paul Barret, Jr. Library
cards.subtitle: Library facilities, Middle Ground, Writing Center & Muslim Prayer Center
cards.notes: Start here when your plan needs several academic supports in one stop; the campus guide lists library facilities, Middle Ground, the Writing Center, and Muslim Prayer Center.
cards.short_summary: A central academic building with multiple listed support and study-oriented destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhodes’ current campus guide lists Paul Barret, Jr. Library with library facilities, Middle Ground, Muslim Prayer Center, and Writing Center.
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to Rhodes library and building-access policies.

cards.title: Middle Ground
cards.subtitle: Inside Paul Barret, Jr. Library
cards.notes: Use this named library destination as a meet-up point before settling into library work; confirm current service and seating arrangements when you arrive.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed destination within the Barret Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhodes’ current campus guide lists Middle Ground within Paul Barret, Jr. Library.
cards.access_notes: Located in the library; access and any food or beverage purchases follow current College policies.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Inside Paul Barret, Jr. Library
cards.notes: Bring a draft or assignment plan and check the Writing Center’s current appointment or walk-in process before relying on a visit for feedback.
cards.short_summary: A campus writing-support destination listed in the Barret Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhodes’ current campus guide lists the Writing Center within Paul Barret, Jr. Library.
cards.access_notes: Check current Writing Center availability and library access policies before visiting.

cards.title: Lynx Lair
cards.subtitle: Bryan Campus Life Center
cards.notes: Choose the Lynx Lair for a low-key recreation break with billiards, game rooms, TV viewing, lounge areas, and a snack bar listed by the College.
cards.short_summary: A student recreation area with games, TV viewing, lounges, and a snack bar.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhodes identifies the L. Palmer Brown Lynx Lair as a student recreation area with a snack bar, billiards, game rooms, TV viewing, and lounge areas.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Bryan Campus Life Center; snack-bar items may require purchase and access may be limited to the Rhodes community.

cards.title: Bryan Campus Life Center
cards.subtitle: Fitness, recreation, and campus-event facilities
cards.notes: Use the BCLC as a hub for a workout or recreation plan; its listed facilities include courts, a fitness room, indoor track, pool, and event spaces.
cards.short_summary: A multi-purpose campus life and recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhodes says the Bryan Campus Life Center includes athletic and fitness facilities, a fitness room, indoor jogging track, courts, pool, and space for student social events and lectures.
cards.access_notes: Use follows current recreation-facility and building-access policies.

cards.entity_name: Brenda and Lester Crain Reception Hall
cards.title: Crain Reception Hall
cards.subtitle: Bryan Campus Life Center
cards.notes: Check the campus events calendar or a registered organization’s plans for scheduled gatherings in this named BCLC reception hall before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A named BCLC venue for campus social events and special occasions.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhodes describes the Brenda and Lester Crain Reception Hall as accommodating campus social events and other special occasions.
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on event scheduling and College access rules.

cards.title: McCallum Ballroom
cards.subtitle: Bryan Campus Life Center
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled lecture, performance, organization event, or campus occasion using this named ballroom; access depends on the individual event.
cards.short_summary: A named ballroom in Rhodes’ campus life center.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhodes’ current campus guide lists McCallum Ballroom in the Bryan Campus Life Center, and the College describes the center as accommodating student social events, lectures, and other campus occasions.
cards.access_notes: Event access, registration, and any ticketing are determined by the organizer.

cards.title: Clough-Hanson Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: S. DeWitt Clough Hall
cards.notes: Add the gallery to an arts-focused walk and check its current exhibition information before visiting; the College maps it in S. DeWitt Clough Hall.
cards.short_summary: A named campus art gallery in S. DeWitt Clough Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhodes’ current campus guide lists the Clough-Hanson Art Gallery in S. DeWitt Clough Hall.
cards.access_notes: Check current exhibition hours and building access before visiting.

cards.title: Hubert F. Fisher Memorial Garden
cards.subtitle: Campus garden with named labyrinth and meditation gardens
cards.notes: Build in a quiet outdoor pause here; the campus guide identifies the Fisher Memorial Garden alongside the Burns Memorial Labyrinth and two meditation gardens.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed garden area with a labyrinth and meditation gardens.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhodes’ current campus guide lists Hubert F. Fisher Memorial Garden, Adrienne McMillan Burns Memorial Labyrinth, Claire Markham Collins Meditation Garden, and James H. Daughdrill Jr. Meditation Garden.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is subject to campus conditions and College policies.

cards.title: Catherine Burrow Refectory
cards.subtitle: Tina McWhorter Dining Room & Wilson Fireside Lounge
cards.notes: Use the Refectory as a dining-plan anchor, then note its listed rooms and lounge when arranging a meal or on-campus meeting around building traffic.
cards.short_summary: Rhodes’ main dining facility, with several named rooms and a fireside lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhodes identifies Catherine Burrow Refectory as the College’s main dining facility; its current campus guide lists the Tina McWhorter Dining Room and Wilson Fireside Lounge there.
cards.access_notes: Dining access and meal purchases follow current Rhodes Dining Services policies.
